verdict.rationale: Beamer's own docs say it lets you 'collect and prioritize feedback' and list a 'Public and private roadmap', which suggests a customer-facing feedback capability. Nothing shows a portal where customers submit ideas and vote on them; changelog comments and reactions are a separate, adjacent feature and get no credit. Missing for 10: a documented public idea-submission portal, a customer voting mechanism on ideas, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can host a public feedback portal where customers submit and vote on ideas

citations.quote: Now, you can easily collect and prioritize feedback—and know how to build more value into your product.
